test_name: Example: reviews on landing page vs. payment page
hypothesis: If we show our review rating in the purchase flow, more visitors will complete it, because ratings are trusted social proof.
experiences: A: default; B: rating on registration page; C: rating on landing page; D: both
result: D: conversion +6%, gross subscriptions +8%, lifetime revenue +9%
lesson: Social proof works when it appears where the decision happens; test placement and format.

hypothesis: If we ask for more details about the person searched for, visitors will find better matches and subscribe more.
experiences: A: default; B: banner asking for more details
result: Signups -10%; gross subscriptions +16%; fewer than 10% of visitors used the banner
lesson: Visitors may not have the information you're asking for; recordings explain why a test lost.
